Task paralysis

What Is Task Paralysis and Why Starting Feels Hard?

Problem: Beginning can feel impossible even when you know what needs to be done.

Try this now: Write the task exactly as it feels, then make the first move smaller than expected.

ADHD Task Initiation: How to Start Without Pressure

Problem: Normal productivity advice can feel like another demand when starting is the hard part.

Try this now: Use your current energy level to choose a smaller starting point.

How to Start a Task When You Feel Overwhelmed

Problem: A large task can feel impossible when the entry point is unclear.

Try this now: Name one visible part of the task and start there for three minutes.

6 min readRead the GuideTask breakdown

How to Break a Big Task Into Small Steps

Problem: A vague task can stay stuck because it is not yet physical enough to begin.

Try this now: Turn the task into one action you can see, touch, open, write, or move.

Why To-Do Lists Do Not Help When You Cannot Start

Problem: To-do lists can show the work, but they do not always help you enter it.

Try this now: Add a first-move layer under the task name.

Brain Dump Productivity: How to Clear Your Head and Begin

Problem: Scattered thoughts can make every task feel equally urgent.

Try this now: Write everything down, then choose only one first move.
